description: Deadlines, optionally for one record (entity + entity_id), by status (open|reminded|done|cancelled), due_within_days (also overdue ones), or mine=true. Sorted by due date.

due_within_days.description: Only deadlines due within this many days, overdue ones included

entity.description: Table of the record (together with entity_id)

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_deadlines
